facts.fact: The Star reports KRA telling the Senate that some Kenyan counties contract financial technology firms to automate and collect revenue on their behalf, vendors charging a percentage of collections.
facts.system: county revenue systems run by vendors

facts.fact: KRA's commissioner general says most counties use the Local Authority Integrated Financial Operations Management System inherited from the defunct local authorities, which operates independently of other systems.
facts.system: Local Authority Integrated Financial Operations Management System

facts.fact: The Star reports some Kenyan counties have yet to automate and still collect revenue manually.

systems.system: Local Authority Integrated Financial Operations Management System
